name: INJ and DEL Benchmarks
description: Two complementary benchmarks evaluating localization methods in large language models by identifying components responsible for memorized data. INJ injects new information into model weights to test localization accuracy, while DEL measures the effect of dropping neurons on memorized sequences.
reputation: A specialized interpretability benchmark that is cited in work on memorization localization, but it has limited mainstream adoption compared with larger general-purpose benchmarks.
notes: Focuses on evaluating localization methods for memorized data in LLMs using two novel benchmarks with complementary perspectives.
